parties.respondent: State (Govt. Of Nct Of Delhi) & Anr.

summary: Obscenity standard for digital content under IT Act; community test applying Aveek Sarkar; language/vulgarity in web-series 'College Romance' not obscene; prurience/depravity threshold unmet; online content context matters; warnings/disclaimers relevant; IT Rules 2021 classification considered; no violation of Sections 67/67A; prosecution quashed; High Court order set aside.
legal_provisions_cited: Indecent Representation of Women (Prohibition) Act, 1986 s.2(c)
Indecent Representation of Women (Prohibition) Act, 1986 s.3
Aveek Sarkar v. State of West Bengal (2014) 4 SCC 257
Sharat Babu Digumarti v. Government (NCT of Delhi) (2017) 2 SCC 18
Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; FIR quashed.
